key_mapping.KEY1: BAT_PWR: Key1 connects U2 ECJ23001-4FCBD6 KEY to GND
key_mapping.KEY2: BOOT: Key2 connects BOOT0 / GPIO28 to GND
key_mapping.KEY3: RESET: Key3 connects CHIP_PU through R41 to GND
key_mapping.scope: Official schematic designators match STEP KEYn names. Physical board revision/labels still to confirm.

actuator.basis: Each original STEP KEYn has a unique planar face with normal approximately -X at the minimum X. Nominal face is 1.8 x 0.8 mm, area 1.4314 mm2, center Z=-6.4000 mm.
actuator.motion_note: 0.4 mm is a candidate CAP guide budget, NOT the switch travel. Mechanical actuation/return and force remain unverified.

usb_body.scope: Published overall product width/height used as body envelope; shoulder/nose not dimensioned. 30 mm continuous prism begins at the STEP metal rim, granting no benefit from a narrow nose. This is not certification of every USB-C cable.

fastener.scope: Geometry envelope only; supplier selection, tightening torque, material and clamping strength require verification.
